blurb: Lake Winnipesaukee’s Premier fishing guide service! I have been a licensed New Hampshire guide since 2006 and have fished the waters of New Hampshire for over 40 years. I have been fortunate enough to be featured on WMUR’s NH Chronicle, as well as Field & Stream’s Hook Shots, Across the Ice Belt with Ice Team on Fox Sports, Meet Marchand and Miller, Charlie Moore No Offense, and numerous appearances on NH’s Wildside
extraNote: Up to 60 Days Prior to Trip: Guests may cancel their reservation and receive a 50% refund of the total booking cost. · 60 Days or Less Prior to Trip: Cancellations made within this period are non-refundable. · Customers more than 30 minutes late without a call, text, or email will be considered a no-show and will not be entitled to a refund or reschedule. · Cancellations for bad weather are at the sole discretion of your guide when fishing conditions become unsafe, not for driving conditions. · We look forward to seeing you.
